## Services

- Home interiors: living rooms, bedrooms, walls, windows, putty, white wash
- Outside and waterproof: exterior walls, terrace and leakage painting
- Decorative: 3D, texture, deco finishes, spray, statue and idol repainting
- Wood and polish: doors, furniture, PU polish, classic polish
- Buildings and workplaces: apartments, buildings, offices
